title: Lower the selected BIT rank-42 residual to one contiguous weighted child
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

The conditional selected BIT stock proofs (PR #2084, #2120) leave residual lowering and child-weight dependencies as implementation obligations. This package binds the **first unhosted rank-42 idle residual of the selected PR589 pipeline** and emits its generic local-ring lowering to **one contiguous 42f-atom weighted child**, checked on the complete two-bank operator.

- **Object:** idle child 6, copy 213, replica 0, pair 0, side 1, port 102, with source-bound projector `P0 = diag(0_22, I_42)` on 64 coarse coordinates. The frozen hosting patterns account for all 288 rank-42 children and select this one deterministically.
- **Lowering:** on the generic class (successive northeast pivots of `P C` are units over `Z/q^w Z`, q an odd prime, no pivot permutation or scaling granted), unit lower ADD normalizers, a lower cross-bank shear, one weighted reversed interchange on the contiguous 42f head prefix and tail suffix, and the inverse adapters execute `G_A` exactly on arbitrary dirty inputs. The child descriptor is `A_child[kf+j] = A[kf+j] · p_k`; it reads frozen parent-derived values and the atom index, never fresh child fields or unused stock. No gather, interleaving, extra child or pivot-normalization pass.
- **Descriptor boundary:** two GL64 parent charts that agree modulo 5 require first child pivots **1 and 11 modulo 25**, so the parent's low matrix alone cannot determine the descriptor. Substituting low-only pivots keeps rank and call shape but changes the operation. This is a counterexample to a weakened interface, not a defect in a selected compiler.
- **Adapter count:** `2f·(nL + nR + nK)` coordinate ADD updates plus one rank-42f child, with `nL, nR ≤ 1785` and `nK ≤ 4096` (a loose bound of 15332f); exact counts are in `RESULT.json`. Converting them to the ordinary-call and tape toll remains open.
- **Status:** a source-bound algebraic compiler component with a scoped proof for the generic unit-pivot branch. The generic normal-form theorem and contiguous index rule are the retained source527 three-stage-cover framework's; the new parts are the selected binding, the executable ordered lowering, an independent direct-operator oracle, the explicit ancestor descriptor and the high-field counterexample. No stock coefficient, supplier or κ change.

**Remaining obligations.**
- Physical prefix-controlled ADD execution and its ordinary-call and tape bill; nongeneric (nonunit-pivot) fallback integration; complete padding and fresh-field cylinders; internally borrowing ordinary leaves.
- Every selected prime, denominator and minor exclusion; native precision, time and space bounds; full selected cold replay.
- Formal-kernel or independent human review; hosted CI. Spectator preservation is shown algebraically, not for a physical stream.

## Task and overlap

- **Task ID / scope key:** `selected-stock-envelope` (`eee4a5467dd91c47ef45`), refined to `selected-PR589/rank42-idle-residual/local-ring-weighted-child/ancestor-descriptor`. Chooser nonce `db5d733383c70adb154598e6abf1bb5c`, track bit-mechanisms, priority revision 4, preserved in `SELECTION.json`. Following revision 4's preference for a live central handoff, this was taken over the chooser's suggestions (`bit-new-register-model`, whose series this account already worked; `bit-helper-contract`, whose immediate scopes are covered). No reroll.
- **Base and exact heads:** base `0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2`, rechecked unchanged at 21:24 UTC; contribution `3ad4f746258a36c80db5869d7beb0f88c71a350e`. The selected PR #589 (`a5afc8c6169ea61ba7c51dfd3cade02cc7b13b46`) is bound through the selected assembly and manifest. Context heads: PR #2084 `8001a23b003bec5dff5e61edec907b652c475932`, PR #2097 `1d3ee0926656d5260c6cb1c0b81964ffe9fe1377`, PR #2120 `378593574261e0b0915e7e8a83147aa640274fc8`, PR #2140 `7ec858702da04d02748a5c05d439f602741a869a`. No pending predecessor executable is imported; eight live inputs on main are pinned by Git blob and SHA-256 in `SOURCES.json`.
- **Scope status:** changed, from numerical stock estimation to one selected compiler implication that PR #2084 and #2120 leave as a realization premise.
- **Nearest work:** PR #2084 and #2120 price conditional stock; PR #2097 proves fresh-fiber counting under field dependencies; PR #2140 lowers one fixed data-port q-adic row route and leaves residual and child descriptors open. Ross Richardson's [complementary claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2114#discussioncomment-18934129) covers the nonunit-pivot fallback; nothing from it is used here. PR #2157, opened after this package's final snapshot, compiles the selected header routes into stream primitives and does not lower residual children.
- **Claim and final check:** the claim is in [discussion #2114](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2114#discussioncomment-18934007). A final overlap check of open PRs and Discussions (complete pagination), plus a live check of newer PRs, found no competing work on this residual.

## Validation

```sh
python3 -B scripts/research_baseline.py
python3 -I -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/selected-bit-weighted-child --check-only
python3 -I -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/selected-bit-weighted-child
python3 -I -O -B research/selected-bit-weighted-child/test_child.py
```

Linux x86_64, CPython 3.12.3, standard library. The registered replay was run again on the final package bytes before submission, under an 8 GiB memory cap: it passed in about 10 seconds and left the worktree unchanged.

```text
PASS_SELECTED_BIT_WEIGHTED_CHILD rank=42 cases=10 basis=768 controls=10 no_new_kappa
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/selected-bit-weighted-child outcome=completed
```

- Ten ring cases (q = 5, 7, 101 and the Lucas-Lehmer-certified 2^89 − 1; w = 1 to 3) check all 128 weighted-operator columns. At q = 5, w = 2 the scalar ADD interpreter matches a separate direct formula on all 768 basis inputs for f = 1, 2, 3, plus dirty inputs in every case.
- All 3,888 GL2(Z/9) charts and their 108 rank-one projectors are enumerated: the 63 generic projectors pass every basis check for f = 1, 2, 3, and the 45 nongeneric ones are rejected.
- Ten semantic controls (weight order, missing tail reversal, omitted restoration, nonunit weights, nongeneric projectors, rank, idempotence, normalizer order and low-only pivots), live-source mutation, missing and corrupted receipts, and an optimized read-only export without Git all reject or pass as expected.
- The finite fixtures support the implementation; the ordered written argument carries the all-width, all-f statement. Executable bounds: dimension at most 64, width at most 8, f at most 3.

- Rohan Arun (PR #1094) and Jeremy Kothe's preceding assembly bind the selected source. This account's PR #1307 and #1421 are earlier hosting and ledger audits; they are not reused as new evidence.

New material is Apache-2.0; retained notices are unchanged.

**AI assistance:** submitted by @commdata2338 with substantial AI assistance. OpenAI Codex (GPT-6 Astra) did the derivation, the implementation, the checking and the writing; it was packaged and submitted with Claude Code. No independent human review is claimed.

## Open next questions

From the package README:
1. **Can the emitted prefix-controlled ADDs receive a complete ordinary-call and tape bill?** First step: one nonconstant `K_A` coefficient, keeping the full parent high field and unused quotient. Blockers: the physical ordered-affine implementation and the internally borrowing ordinary leaf.
2. **Can the retained unit-pivot fallback be emitted for a nongeneric selected residual with the same descriptor dependency?** Coordinate with the active fallback claim in #2114 and compare the two interfaces on the same selected projector, checking the full 128-dimensional operator and the charged child list. Treating residue-zero entries as zero modulo q^w is invalid.
